message:
Lena, Farah, the sun field covers holding plus the capped warm batch with margin, where Photovoltaic (PV) means solar panels. Plain words, the daily cooling need uses about two-thirds of what the panels make. Numbers are 5.60 kWh per day, as 3.60 kWh holding from the daily electric kWh from 150 W continuous (E52) plus 2.00 kWh batch from the daily batch electric for 200 kg (E55), against 8.10 kWh per day from the daily PV yield from 2.4 kWp (E54), fraction 0.691 from the fraction of PV yield used (E56), sane against about half a household day.

Lena, Kofi, the night rides through on stored charge with reserve, where Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) means the battery chemistry. Plain words, one long night uses less than half the battery. Numbers are 2.10 kWh for 14 h night from the night energy at 150 W (E57) against 5.12 kWh stored from the EG4 LifePower4 battery datasheet (E9), fraction 0.410 from the night fraction of battery (E58), managed by the 60 A controller from the Rover Lite charge controller datasheet (E10), sane against a small household overnight load.

Not ready, because peak chiller watts and cooling hours for the 200 kg batch with Lena must be locked before Direct Current (DC) wire and fuse sizes freeze, where Direct Current means one-direction electricity.
